backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing student management system with user profiles, student records, marks tracking, and attendance recording, all protected by role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: student records management, marks recording, attendance tracking, and education-focused UI theme, each mapped to specific frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components describing routing, forms, pages, hooks, and styling for the student management application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom CSS variables defining a comprehensive design system using OKLCH color space for light and dark modes with education-focused color palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with title 'Tarun Coaching Center Student Tracker' and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, students, marks, attendance, and login pages, plus authentication flow and profile setup modal integration.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceForm.t: Form component for recording individual student attendance with date picker, student ID input, and present/absent toggle switch, including callback props for parent state updates.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceHistor: Display component showing attendance statistics (percentage, present/absent counts) and chronological list of attendance records with color-coded visual indicators and progress bar.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component providing navigation header with logo, menu items (Home, Students, Marks, Attendance), user profile display, and logout functionality. Includes responsive mobile menu and conditional rendering based on authentication status.
frontend/src/components/MarkForm.tsx: Form component for adding student marks with fields for student ID, subject, exam type, and score (0-100). Includes validation and displays an alert noting that student ID must be entered manually until getAllStudents() is implemented.
frontend/src/components/MarksHistory.tsx: Displays a student's marks history grouped by subject, showing exam types, scores, and calculated grades (A+ to F) with performance trend icons. Includes loading states and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, collecting name and role (Teacher/Administrator/Staff). Cannot be dismissed until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/StudentForm.tsx: Form component for adding new students with fields for name, roll number, grade/class, and contact number. Clears form on successful submission and supports optional success callback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Handles actor initialization with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and authentication status tracking. Includes provider component and useInternetIdentity hook for accessing auth state throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, including user profile management, student operations, marks tracking, and attendance recording with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components like sidebar, cards, buttons, and charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Attendance management page with forms for marking attendance and viewing history, includes an alert noting that bulk attendance requires getAllStudents() backend method.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Dashboard homepage displaying a hero banner with user greeting, feature cards linking to students/marks/attendance sections, and quick stats overview.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication, displays branding and handles login flow with error recovery for already-authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/MarksPage.tsx: Marks management page with forms for adding marks and viewing history, includes an alert noting that student selection requires getAllStudents() backend method.
frontend/src/pages/StudentsPage.tsx: Student management page with add student dialog and search functionality, displays alert that student list/edit/delete features require missing backend methods (getAllStudents, updateStudent, deleteStudent).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme colors using OKLCH color space, typography, container settings, animations, and design tokens for a component library.
project_state.json: Project metadata for Tarun Coaching Center student tracking application, documenting existing features (student records, marks, attendance interfaces) and pending backend implementation requirements.
